card.name: Words opening a future-condition clause
card.fires_on: Words like when, every, whenever, anything, any future, or always that start a clause about what happens from now on or whenever something recurs. Seen in general advice and how-to text.

modes.label: When/every/whenever
modes.description: Time-trigger words that begin a recurring-situation clause.
modes.example: Then<< when>> you need to measure something on the course

modes.label: Any/anything/future
modes.description: Open-ended words saying that from now on something applies.
modes.example: Now<< anything>> you do with your zombies (or whatever

modes.label: Words after you or anyone
modes.description: A verb or modal right after a subject in an if-ever clause.
modes.example: so if anyone<< asks>> this question again you can look into it

card.writes: Little clear effect; it seems to promote words about later or ongoing time such as afterward and 往后.
card.plain: It marks words that start a 'from now on' or 'any time that happens' clause.
